subject.title: [Feature]: Move away from useMultiFileAuthState for Baileys

question: Should the bundled WhatsApp plugin replace Baileys multi-file authentication state with a canonical durable store now, and which supported storage and migration contract should it own?
rationale: This changes persistent credential and Signal-key ownership, migration, recovery, and operational security behavior; source evidence alone cannot select the acceptable long-term contract.

options.title: Sponsor a canonical migration
options.body: Define a WhatsApp-plugin-owned durable auth-store and a tested one-way migration with recovery guarantees.

options.title: Retain file persistence with bounded hardening
options.body: Keep the current Baileys format while documenting its supported deployment limits and prioritizing only targeted corruption or performance fixes.

options.title: Move ownership outside the bundled plugin
options.body: Decide that a reusable persistence seam is needed first, then scope that API separately before replacing the current store.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a canonical migration
recommendation.body: Define a WhatsApp-plugin-owned durable auth-store and a tested one-way migration with recovery guarantees.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent auth persistence and recovery changes make mcaxtr the strongest evidence-backed routing candidate.
